key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI reached the right decision (reject rewrite, ETL-first modernization) by cost-benefit recomputation but never played the losing side's best defender — it inherited the memo's 'band-aid, tried 3x and failed' frame, left the 90%-untested-behavior risk unpriced, and skipped the survivor test (3.7 vs 4.6). The routed dual-run (m018 steelman first-class with the strongest-form + steelman-vs-critique separation contract, m019 adversary, m070 synthesis) plus the m003/m007 gates closed every rubric item: straw-man named and set aside, all four evidence-grounded arguments (re-derivation cost of 340 fixes, ETL as the real goal gap, staffing math, attempt-history reframing) rebuilt and addressed quantitatively, deepest objection answered by sequencing — the decision matches the human baseline and now provably survives the strongest opposing case.
learning_signal: Steel-manning is a first-class dialectical move with a completion contract: the opposing position must be rebuilt in its strongest defensible form (the proponent would accept it) BEFORE critique, with the steelman and the critique physically separated — otherwise the agent evaluates the losing alternative as listed and cannot show its decision survives the best version of it; the straw-man dismissal in the source text is evidence about the author, never the position itself.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m018 pass contract on decision memos with an explicit opposing position: require (1) straw-man named and set aside, (2) >=3 evidence-grounded arguments rebuilt from the fixed evidence, (3) quantitative address per rebuilt argument, (4) survivor test — the deepest objection answered, not dodged; pair with m003 inversion (guarantee-goals) and m007 ruin screen (high_stakes) as standing gates; verify by re-deriving each rebuilt argument from the appendix, never from the memo's framing.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline rebuilt 'don't roll back' into its strongest defensible form, added a verification pass, promoted the evidence-free LB hypothesis to an open co-equal risk in the final recommendation, and paid ~$150K + refund liability for the courtesy (rollback at 14:19 vs penalty trip at 14:13; 3.0/5). The routed run excluded the trap style at META (m018 out of top-3 — router NEG trap-avoidance), ran m021 OODA as the first-class pass with tempo mode (P2 deadline, cost-of-delay explicit, commit at DO), screened each objection under burden of proof via the mandatory m006 provenance audit (scenarios 90/5/5, posterior range 85-95%, threshold flip at P<30%) and m007 ruin screen (both branches priced incl. failure), and executed the rollback inside the window — 0 penalty minutes, the objection logged as screening-rejected rather than as an open risk.
learning_signal: Steel-manning's registry weaknesses (time cost; can legitimize bad arguments) are context-triggered: on deadline+high_stakes+unmeasured incident signatures the rebuild must be screened out BEFORE it runs — an objection whose claims carry no measured signal or named mechanism is rejected under burden of proof, never granted dialectical status; screening is not denying the objection's possibility, it is the cost-optimal tempo when the environment prices delay.
suggested_improvement: Keep the trap-avoidance route (m018 out of top-3 on incident signatures) and add a standing evidence-free-objection log to the packet: every objection must carry a measured signal or a named mechanism or it is recorded as screening-rejected, never as an open risk; require tempo mode (cost-of-delay sentence + commit at DO) on all deadline contexts; verify by re-running the clock arithmetic against the penalty terms inside the packet.
